name: v26.11
body:
Release post: <https://mau.fi/blog/2026-11-mautrix-release/>

### Backend
* Added RFC 10036 `Incremental` header for SSE connections so compatible reverse proxies like Caddy disable buffering.
* Added per-message profile info to push data.
* Added support for FCM push gateways specified by the frontend.
  * Currently, the push gateways need to be whitelisted in the config.
* Added support for OAuth step-up auth with existing OAuth login methods.
* Added methods for viewing and updating room directory.
* Added config option to not delete media cache on logout.
  * This is recommended if you share the media cache between multiple instances.
* Added method to get the MSC4391 definitions of internal gomuks commands (thanks to @Henry-Hiles in #773).
* Added method for upgrading rooms (thanks to @Henry-Hiles in #774).
* Added caching theme proxy.
  * To use it, simply replace `https://css.gomuks.app` with `_gomuks` in your CSS imports.
  * The cache will keep previously loaded themes working even if it can't reach css.gomuks.app.
  * If you link to a specific commit, the backend will cache it permanently and will never refetch. Non-specific commits are refetched at most once an hour.
* Changed `get_mentions` to never return a null array.
* Changed default build scripts to build with goolm.
* Changed event processing to preserve unknown top-level fields. They'll be placed under a custom `unknown_top_level` field.
* Fixed event decryption lock not being acquired for sync properly, which lead to some database queries timing out and failing due to deadlocks.

### Web
* Bumped minimum browser versions to Firefox 153, Chrome 155 and Safari 27.
* Added support for stable policy list rooms.

### C FFI
* Added push message info to push notification handling instead of only returning raw event and room info.   
  * Clients should prefer using only the pre-processed push data.
* Added method to reset network connections.
  * Clients should listen to OS-level network change events and call this to reconnect faster.
* Added method to pause sync without stopping the client entirely.
* Added `GomuksAllocBuffer` for platforms where malloc isn't easily available (thanks to @Henry-Hiles in #771).
